title: Share a chef dinner at South Beach Wine & Food Festival
description: Amid SOBEWFF’s larger tastings and crowds, a seated chef dinner offers time to focus on one menu and the people around your table. Choose an event that appeals to your palate, then follow the sequence of dishes and conversations through the evening. Miami’s festival brings many culinary voices together, so the particular dinner you choose matters.
teaser: Choose a seated chef dinner during Miami’s food festival.
goodToKnow: The 2027 festival is scheduled for February 25–28. Choose and reserve a specific dinner from the current program.
whyItMightDelightYou: A smaller table gives you time to notice the ideas and people behind each course.
